query: One app contract approves a vivid editorial marketing surface and compact workspace tables with neutral surfaces and top filters. A second app shares the component package but has a different brand. Design a marketing page, a workspace table, and one shared-package screen for the second app.
expected_behavior: Applies only the approved marketing and workspace scopes for the first app
Does not use the marketing register to waive workspace patterns
Looks up the second app's own contract and does not copy the first app's palette or visual treatment based on shared code
Does not invent new product-wide rules from the request
